Smite:

Upgrade: 1d12 Holy damage.

Upgrade: 2d6+2 HP, can cast 2x per battle.

Upgrade: 3d8+3 HP, can cast 3x per battle.

Upgrade: 4d10+4 HP, can cast 4x per battle.

Benediction:

Upgrade: Up to 3 allies within 10 spaces. Allies add 1d8 to their next d20 roll.

Turn Undead:
6 actions. Stuns all Tier 1 undead within 5 spaces for 5 turns. Intimidation vs Will.

Upgrade: Deals 5d12 arcane damage to all Tier 1 undead. Stuns all Tier 2 undead for 3 turns.

Upgrade: Deals 5d12 arcane damage to all Tier 2 undead. Stuns all Tier 3 undead for 1 turn.

Upgrade: Deals 5d12 arcane damage to all Tier 3 undead.
Bane:
4 actions. Chastises all targets within 3 spaces, who suffer a 1d4 penalty to the damage of their attacks. Lasts 2 turns. Intimidate vs Will.

Upgrade: All targets within 6 spaces suffer 1d10 damage penalty.
Mass Cure Wounds:
6 Actions. Heals all allies in a 3x3 area within 10 spaces for 1d4+1 HP. Spirituality vs Will.

Upgrade: 2d6+2 HP, 4x4 area, can cast 2x in battle

Upgrade: 4d10+4 HP, 5x5 area, can cast 3x in battle
Rejuvenate:
4 actions. You heal yourself or an ally within 10 spaces for small increments over time. They heal 1d4 Health each turn until they die, reach full health, or the end of battle. Spirituality vs Will.

Upgrade: This effect now stacks up to 3x per target, and you may cast it up to 6x in battle.

Upgrade: This effect now stacks up to 5x per target, and you may cast it as often as you'd like in battle.

5 actions. You grant 15 Temp HP to a target within 10 spaces. Attacks against Temp HP bypass all Armor. You may split this up among multiple targets. Temp HP lasts for 10 turns or until depleted. Spirituality vs Will.

Upgrade: 30 Temp HP.

Augury: 24 actions. You ask your deity about the result of a specific action you will make in the next half hour. They give you a sign: Weal (good fortune), Woe (bad fortune), both, or none. This can only be used once per day. Must roll 15+ Spirituality.
Calm: 6 actions. You release a calming aura to everyone within 10 spaces. This nullifies all charms, haunts, intimidations, and aggressions for as long as you keep casting (though the effects may return after you dismiss it). Command: 4 actions. You command a target you can see to lie face down. Lasts 5 turns, after which they instantly right themselves. Spirituality vs Will.
Spirit Weapon: 6 actions. You conjure a floating melee weapon made purely of divine energy within 3 spaces. You may send this weapon flying for 2 spaces per action. You may strike a target next to the weapon - if so, it requires that weapon's action cost and deals its damage as Holy damage (bypassing armor). Holy damage done cannot exceed twice your level. Weapon lasts for 5 turns. Spirituality vs Fortitude.
Prayer: 3 actions. All targets within 2 spaces heal 3d8+3 HP. Spirituality vs Will.
Gods' Reach: Passive. All of your Sainthood abilities now have a range of 50 spaces.
Beacon Of Hope: 5 actions. You and all allies within 6 spaces of you gain +6 Will, and subsequent healing on them is done at maximum value. Lasts for 4 turns. Spirituality vs Will.
Warding Bond: 3 actions. You link to a target you can see. They gain +1 Fortitude, and half the damage they take is instead taken by you. Lasts until dismissed or until one of you dies. Spirituality vs Will.
Heroes' Feast:
24 actions. You bring forth a large mound of food and water that can feed up to 3 people heartily. If they spend half an hour consuming it, they heal 2d6 HP. Food lasts 1 hour or until consumed. Spirituality.

Upgrade: Feeds up to 8 people, heals 3d8 HP.
True Sight: 3 actions. You or an ally can detect traps and see past illusions and lies for 5 turns. Arcana vs Will.
Speak With Dead: 24 actions. You animate the body of a corpse within 3 spaces. The corpse must have a mouth and cannot be undead. Spirit Guardian: 6 actions. You or an ally are protected by a Spirit Guardian for 4 turns. If an enemy attacks your ally, the Spirit Guardian strikes them for 3d6 damage. Double damage if the enemy is Undead or Demonic. Spirituality vs Will.
Freedom: 4 actions. A target you can see is no longer affected by movement-impairing effects. They have +2 Move actions per turn and cannot be moved against their will. Other effects from those attacks still apply. Lasts 3 turns. Cure Wounds spell. Persuasion vs Will.
Hallow: 300 actions. You designate an area up to 12x12 spaces to become holy. No Undead, Demons, nor Spirits can enter this area. It is also teleportation-proof. Anyone who enters the area is free from any mind-altering effects, heals 1 HP per minute, and can understand any spoken language. Lasts 1 day. Spirituality vs Will.
Gentle Repose: 600 actions. You conduct a ritual that blesses a corpse. The corpse is protected from all spells that would bring it to undeath, and for the next week, it is protected from decay. Spirituality.
Holy Weapon:
6 actions. You bless a weapon next to you. This weapon will deal an extra 1d8 Holy damage (bypassing armor) with each successful attack. If dismissed prematurely, it will issue a Holy blast that deals 3d8 Holy damage to all targets within 2 spaces. Lasts 10 turns or until dismissed. Spirituality.

Upgrade: 2d8 Holy damage with each successful attack, Holy blast 6d8 Holy damage.
Flame Strike:
12 actions. A 4x4-area pillar of Holy fire blasts down from the sky, dealing 3d6 Holy damage to all targets within it. Spirituality vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: 6d6 Holy damage.

Forbiddance: 24 actions. You bless a vicinity, up to an 80x80 area. This vicinity prevents teleportation, both in and out, to and from any plane. Holy Aura: 6 actions. You cause everyone within 6 spaces to glow, including yourself. Your targets either take 1d8 Holy damage each turn and suffer -10 Stealth, or heal 1d4 HP with every attack they make (you may pick who gets what effect). All effects last 5 turns. Spirituality vs Will.

Pelor: An ally deals 1d4 damage (bypassing armor) to all adjacent enemies.

Corellon: Any ally gains +5 Persuasion and Perform.
Erathis: An ally gains +3 Armor.
Ioun: An ally sets an Intelligence skill equal to their highest skill.
Kord: An ally sets a Strength skill equal to their highest skill for 4 turns.
Melora: An ally can speak with plants and animals.
Raven Queen: An ally gains +20 Insight to determine a target's intention.
Sehanine: An ally gains +5 Arcana to Illusion and Alteration spells.
Asmodeus: An ally gains 1 Temporary HP for every 5 damage they deal.
Bane: An ally may steal another ally’s turn each round of combat.
Gruumsh: An ally gains +1 damage for every 4 HP they are missing.
Lolth: An ally gains +10 Will against all effects that intrude, alter, or change the mind.
Tiamat: An ally gains +4 Stealth and can find 1.5x as much money than normal.
Torog: An ally can see through 10 feet of wall.
Vecna: An ally gains +4 Enchantments and slows all adjacent enemies 1 action each turn.
Zehir: An ally can see in total darkness and is immune to poisons.
Amoth: An ally returns half damage to their attackers.
Aoskar: An ally gains +4 Move actions.
Gorellik: An ally chooses a race. They gain the Favored Enemy feat against that race.
He Who Was: An ally heals 1d4 HP each turn.
Lakal: An ally takes +3 extra to heals on them.
Maglubiyet: An ally has +4 Persuasion and can duplicate 1 non-magical item.
Nerull: An ally can see and speak with dead spirits. These spirits must have died within the vicinity.
Tuern: An ally gains +1 damage per ally on their team and +1 Armor for all enemies focusing on them.

All effects last 4 turns. Spirituality vs Will.
Resurrection:
Requires a body, dead but not entirely decomposed.

Boisterous: 1 action. You may take the higher of 2 rolls next time you use your Aggression skill. Aggression vs Will.
Leap: X actions. Jump up to 6 spaces and attack a target within weapon range for 1W damage when you land. Weapon vs Defense.
Stun: X actions. Requires melee weapon. Attack an adjacent target for 1W damage. They lose 6 actions on their next turn. Weapon vs Fortitude.
Slam: X actions. Requires melee weapon. Attack an adjacent target for 1W damage and push them back 2 spaces. Passive. You may add a 1-space knockback to all attacks made with a Heavy weapon. If the target is a structure, attacks instead deal 1d12 extra damage.

Unarmed Mastery: Passive. While Unarmed, melee attacks cost -1 action, down to a minimum of 1.

Straightshot Mastery: Passive. If your Ranged weapon cannot reach targets more than 20 spaces away, it costs -1 action to use, down to a minimum of 1.
Leader: 3 actions. You and 3 targets within 10 spaces gain +4 Fortitude, Reflex, Will, and +2 Armor, also healing 5 HP each turn. Lasts 5 turns. Persuasion vs Will.

- Form Up: Your targets gain +5 Survival, +5 Intimidate, and +5 Will. However, they must end their turn within 2 spaces of you.
- Hold Position: You outline a 4x4 area within 10 spaces. Your targets must move to that area and cannot leave there. However, they gain +1 to Armor and all Defenses while there.

Minute Meteors: 3 actions. Summon 6 tiny meteors that float around you. For 1 action, you can send one zooming to a space. All targets on and next to that space take 1d8 damage. Unused meteors last 10 turns. Arcana vs Reflex.
Wall Of Sand: 9 actions. Summons 2x10 area wall of sand. In this area, all physical damage is halved, all targets are blinded, and moving requires 3 actions instead of 1. Lasts until called off. Arcana vs Fortitude.
Sanctum:
Passive. Casting a single-target Abjuration spell (Weapon Ward, Absorb Elements, Shield, Thought Shield, Ballistics Shield, Platinum Shield, or Stoneskin) affects all allies next to the target while it lasts.

Upgrade: Affects all allies within 3 spaces of the target.
Stoneskin:
5 actions. You focus on a target within 3 spaces and turn their skin to a stone-like substance. They gain +3 Fortitude and +2 Armor. Lasts 5 turns. Arcana vs Will.

Upgrade: Target's skin becomes an iron-like substance. +6 Fortitude, +4 Armor.

Upgrade: Target's skin becomes a steel-like substance. Attacks against Fortitude must now take the lesser of 2d20 rolls.
Elemental Bane: Reaction. Will cost 2 actions on your next turn. You change the element of an attack being made from one (acid, fire, frost, lightning, or sonic) into another. Any damage dealt will stay the same. Arcana vs Will.
Fabricate:
X actions. You craft an item using Arcana instead of the necessary Crafting skill. You must still have the raw materials needed for the item. Must roll X Arcana.

(X: Actions and skill rolls dependent on item being crafted.)
Polymorph:
6 actions. Turn a target within 10 spaces into a harmless critter. If damaged, the critter will instantly revert back to its original form with its previous HP. Lasts 3 turns. Arcana vs Will.

Upgrade: Can cast on 3 targets. The critters can take 10 points of damage before reverting (they will keep their original HP). Lasts 5 turns.

Upgrade: Can cast on 10 targets. The critters can take 20 points of damage before reverting (they will keep their original HP). Lasts 10 turns.
System Backdoor: 6 actions. You gain complete access to a computer device, which you may operate like an administrator. You can keep using this for up to 1 hour. Afterward, your activity will still show, but you will be unidentifiable. Arcana vs Software.
Construct:
18 actions. Requires a tiny sample of stone, metal, or clay. You create a mindless Golem to do your bidding. The golem is Medium sized, mute (but understands any languages you speak), and shuffles around at normal speed. It has no will of its own, and will do whatever you ask, even at harm to itself. The golem's HP is equal to your Will, has 0 Defenses, with Armor equal to your Enchantments, and uses your Arcana for its own attacks. Its spells are as follows:
- 4 actions. It slams an adjacent target for 2d12 bludgeoning damage. Arcana vs Fortitude.
- 4 actions. It kicks at a target, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning damage and limiting them to 2 Move actions on their next turn. Arcana vs Fortitude.
- 2 actions. It roars, forcing all targets within 3 spaces to attack it on their next turn. Arcana vs Will.
The Golem lasts 1 hour, or until dismissed or defeated. Must roll 26+ Arcana.
Dimension Door:
12 actions. Summons a 2-meter door that leads to anywhere on your plane that you can visualize. Cannot open on an occupied space. Lasts 3 turns or until called off. Must roll 26+ Arcana.

Upgrade: You may place a permanent sigil on the ground that acts as a Dimension Door. Only one who knows this spell can activate it, but they may take up to 10 nearby allies with them.

Upgrade: Becomes Dimensional Gate - you may travel to other planes of existence.
Elemental:
18 actions. Requires a tiny sample of fire, air, water, or dirt/soil. You create an Elemental to do your bidding. The elemental is Medium sized, mute (but understands any languages you speak), and hovers at normal speed. It will do whatever you ask, short of causing harm to itself. The elemental's HP is equal to your Will, uses your Arcana for its own attacks, and its defenses are dependent on the type of elemental summoned. Its attacks are as follows:
- If Fire, it has 0 Will, Reflex equal to your Enchantments, and Fortitude equal to your Insight. For 4 actions, it throws flame from itself in a 1x3 area, dealing 3d8 fire damage and instantly igniting anyone in it. Arcana vs Reflex.
- If Air, it has Will equal to your Insight, Reflex equal to your Enchantments, and 0 Fortitude. For 4 actions, it throws all targets in a 2x2 space within 3 spaces up in the air, where they float for 1 turn, taking a -10 penalty to all attacks. On the next turn, they land knocked down, and must spend 3 actions to pick themselves up. Arcana vs Reflex.
- If Water, it has Will equal to your Enchantments, Reflex equal to your Insight, and 0 Fortitude. For 4 actions, it slams 2 adjacent targets, dealing 2d4 bludgeoning damage, and reducing all their Defenses by -4 for 1 turn. Arcana vs Fortitude.
- If Earth, it has Will equal to your Insight, 0 Reflex, and Fortitude equal to your Enchantments. For 4 actions, it pounds the ground, dealing 1d6 damage to all targets within 3 spaces and preventing their Move actions for 1 turn. Arcana vs Fortitude.
The Elemental lasts 1 hour, or until dismissed or defeated. Must roll 26+ Arcana.
The Big Hand: 5 actions. You summon a hand up to Large size on an unoccupied space. It moves as your own dominant hand does, with a speed of 3 spaces per action. It has 0 armor, your Reflex, and its max HP is the same as your own. It can attack adjacent targets for 1d8 impact damage (2 actions) and push them around 1 space per action. Must roll 26+ Arcana.
Arcane Eye:
18 actions. Summons a floating, 1-inch translucent orb to your side. You can see through this orb as if it were an extra eye. The Eye can only use actions to float around at normal speed. It is tangible and has 1HP. It can move anywhere on this plane. Lasts until called off. Must roll 26+ Arcana.

Upgrade: The Eye is now completely invisible, and can see clearly in the dark.
Divination: 24 actions. Requires a material offering, which will be burned up upon casting the spell. You commune with one of the gods, determined by your type of offering. Only you can see and hear them, and you may ask about an event to occur within the next week. How accurate and truthful their answer is depends on the value of your offering.
Elemental Shield: 4 actions. You provide yourself or a target with a magical shield, made either of flames or frost. With a flame shield, the target cannot be slowed down from cold, and melee attackers are instantly ignited. With a frost shield, the target takes half fire damage, and slows down melee attackers by -4 actions. Lasts 5 turns. Arcana vs Will.
Ice Storm: 9 actions. You hit a 4x4 area with a blizzard. Everyone in the area takes 3d4 frost damage per turn and cannot use any move actions. You can move the blizzard at 1 space per action. Lasts until called off. Arcana vs Fortitude.
Storm Sphere:
9 actions. Summons a sphere of raging wind within 3 spaces. Each turn, you may spend 1 action to move the sphere 1 space or launch a bolt of lightning out of it, dealing 1d10 damage to a target within 10 spaces (tripled if 7+ armor). Anyone on the sphere's space takes 1d8 impact damage. Lasts 10 turns or 4 bolts of lightning. Arcana vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: Sphere takes up 2x2 area. Can hold 6 bolts of lightning.

Upgrade: Sphere takes up 3x3 area. Can hold 8 bolts of lightning.

Upgrade: Sphere takes up 4x4 area. Can hold 10 bolts of lightning. Lightning deals 2d10 damage.
Firewall:
6 actions. Unleashes a 1x12 wall of fire in either a straight line or a ring. Anyone who is in the same space as the fire takes 1d6 fire damage with 1/3 ignition chance. Projectiles, such as bullets and arrows, have a similar chance of burning up instead of passing through. Lasts 5 turns. Arcana vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: 2d6 fire damage, 2/3 ignition chance.

Upgrade: 3d6 fire damage, guaranteed ignition.

Upgrade: 5d6 fire damage.
Location Ward: 12 actions. Affects certain available environments to serve you. All doors in your vicinity become magically locked, all hallways become foggy, all stairways become crooked and uneven, and all statues/suits of armor protect from intruders. Lasts 1 day. Must roll 30+ Arcana.
Platinum Shield: 4 actions. Summons a glowing tower shield that floats in front of an ally, giving them +15 Reflex and +11 Fortitude. The shield is impenetrable, so the ally's attacks suffer -5 accuracy, and it glows, preventing them from using Stealth. For 1 action, you may switch the shield to another ally within 5 spaces. Lasts 3 turns. Arcana vs. Will.
Shutdown: 5 actions. Powers off all electronic devices within 20 spaces of you. If you choose, you may continue casting for up to 10 turns to keep the devices powered off. Arcana vs Software.
Skill Empowerment: 6 actions. Doubles the skill score of a target you touch. Lasts as long as you keep casting, up to 5 turns. Arcana vs Will.
Transmute Earth: 12 actions. You turn any amount (up to Large size) of earth into another type of earth. Types include sand, mud, clay, stone, powder, or gemstone. Lasts 1 minute, or 5 turns if cast in combat. Must roll 30+ Arcana.
Draconic Spirit:
18 actions. Summons a drake. See your GM for its Stats. Roll 1d6 to determine which element it uses. It will serve you for 1 hour. You may cast this once per day. Must roll 30+ Arcana.

Upgrade: Instead of a younger drake, summons a Dragon.

Upgrade: Instead of a Dragon, summons a Grand Dragon.
Instant Switch:
12 actions. You bond 2 nonmagical, nonliving objects. While carrying 1 of the objects, you may switch its exact location with the other object. This move does not take up any actions. Neither object can be bigger than yourself. Lasts until dismissed. Must roll 30+ Arcana.

Upgrade: You may bond up to 3 objects, but switching now costs 1 action.

Upgrade: You may bond up to 4 objects, but switching now costs 2 actions.
Scatter:
6 actions. Teleports up to 5 targets you can see to new spaces you can see. These spaces must be safe (i.e. on the ground, not on lava or a trap). Arcana vs Will.

Upgrade: Up to 10 targets.
Steel Strike:
5 actions. You summon a flurry of shortswords that fling out in a 1x5 cone from you. Everyone in this cone is hit for 3d8 slashing damage. When the swords hit the ground, they disappear. You may keep casting this for 1 turn. Arcana vs Reflex.

Upgrade: 6d8 slashing damage.
City Commune: 18 actions. You listen to the town or city around you, gathering what it has to say. You may add Arcana to your Culture skill to gain a general understanding of the area, including all pathways, influential people, and markets. You may also choose to learn 1 of the following: Water sources, the Electric grid, the Criminal underground, or Magical/Alien elements. Can only cast once per day. Must roll 25+ Culture.
Scry: 12 actions. You witness your target visually and audially from any location. If anyone in the target's vicinity has True Sight, they can see your presence. Lasts for 1 hour. Arcana vs Will.
Telepathy: Telepathy: You can transmit your thoughts into others’ minds, and read their thoughts in return. (WIS vs Will)
Contingency: X actions. Requires a separate spell. You cast the spell, but its effect does not happen. Instead, you save the spell within your being to be cast instantaneously at a time you choose. Lasts until the spell is used. If you cast Contingency again, the new spell replaces the old one. Arcana vs Will.
Flash Frost:
3 actions. You flash freeze everyone in a 1x5 cone, dealing 1d4 damage and immobilizing them in ice. Affected targets cannot make physical actions, including speaking. The ice lasts 1 turn or until it takes 15 damage. Arcana vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: 2d4 damage, ice lasts 2 turns or until it takes 30 damage.

Upgrade: 3d4 damage, ice lasts 3 turns or until it takes 45 damage.
Immolate:
3 actions. You set a target you can see aflame with magical fire, treating them as if they were ignited. This fire cannot be put out by anything but magic for 5 turns. Arcana vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: The fire cannot be put out by anything but magic for 10 turns.

Upgrade: The fire cannot be put out by anything but magic.
Wall Of Anything: 9 actions. Summons a 1x12 wall of a raw material that is close to you and that you speak aloud. The wall will make the terrain either difficult or impassable, depending on the material used. Any extra effects also depend on the material used, which could be as simple as Thorns, Ice, Wood, Light, etc. If you choose not to use any materials, it simply conjures an impassable, invisible Wall Of Force. Afterward, the wall harmlessly crumbles and the original material is returned to normal. Lasts 5 turns. Arcana vs Reflex.
Antimagic Field: 6 actions. Ends all magical effects, including summons and enchantments, within 20 spaces, and prevents new magical effects from happening. You may keep casting this for 9 turns. Arcana vs. Will.
Stunning Symbol:
12 actions. You place an invisible symbol on a flat surface. When anyone comes within 3 spaces of the symbol, you will be alerted. You may then choose to dismiss the symbol, stunning everyone in that area for 1 minute or until they take 20 damage. Symbol lasts until dismissed. Arcana vs Will.

Upgrade: Targets stunned for 10 minutes or until they take 50 damage.
Homunculus: 24 actions. You create a homunculus, a demihuman creature you share a certain bond with. Choose an amount of your max HP to sacrifice. The homunculus' max HP will be that + your Arcana score. The homunculus is its own being with its own will, but recognizes you as its creator and will generally serve you. (See your GM for its stats.) You share a telepathic link, which allows you to exchange vision and thoughts no matter how far apart you are. If the homunculus dies, the HP you sacrificed is returned to you. Lasts until it dies. Must roll 33+ Arcana.
Otherworldly Form:
12 actions. You imbue yourself with a spirit of the Arcane Realm, giving you these bonuses:
- You take no damage from fire or poison.
- Charms and Persuasions against you must take the lower of 2d20 rolls.
- You have spectral wings, and can fly 1 space per action.
- You gain +4 Armor.
- All of your Attack rolls are replaced with an Enchantments roll.
- All of your physical attacks cost -1 action, down to a minimum of 1.
Lasts 10 turns. Must roll 33+ Arcana.
Toughen: 4 actions. Must be Centered. You trade up to 8 Reflex to gain that many points in Fortitude. This ability can be used in reverse as well. Lasts 5 turns. Afterward, this will uncenter you. Arcana.
Arcane Mansion: 24 actions. Summons a mansion of your own design, up to 100x100 spaces. The mansion comes fully furnished and staffed with 100 servants. These servants are translucent, though you may give them any other appearance, and can be commanded to do anything but harm. There is also enough food to serve 100 people. Anything brought outside the mansion will evaporate into smoke. The mansion lasts for 1 day. Must roll 33+ Arcana.
Blade Of Disaster:
12 actions. Summons a flying greatsword in an unoccupied space you can see. This sword has 6 actions of its own. It can fly 2 spaces per action and swing at a target for 3 actions. It deals 2d12 damage per swing, and it is immune to all damage itself. Lasts for 5 turns or until dismissed. Must roll 33+ Arcana.

Upgrade: 3d12 damage.
Demiplane: 4 actions. Creates a pocket dimension that takes the form of a 6x6 area room of wood or stone. This also creates a door to the dimension, which takes on the appearance of your choosing - though it can only fit size Medium beings. The door lasts 5 turns before it disappears. Recasting this may summon the original pocket dimension, or you may create a new one. Can only cast once per day. Must roll 33+ Arcana.
Maze: 5 actions. Banishes your target to a labyrinth pocket dimension. Each turn, the target must roll their Survival against your initial Arcana roll. If they succeed, they free themselves and return. If they fail, they remain trapped and your initial Arcana roll loses 1 point. Lasts until dismissed or your target is free. Arcana vs Will.
Foresight: 6 actions. You or an ally you touch are granted Foresight. During this time, your ally can see the immediate future. They gain +5 Fortitude, Reflex, and Will, and all attacks against them (including ranged stealth) must take the lower of 2d20 rolls. Lasts 10 turns. Arcana vs Will.
Chain Lightning: Passive. If there is someone within 5 spaces of your Generator target, you may chain the lightning over to attack them as well. The lightning can chain to as many untouched targets within 5 spaces as you like.
Otiluke's Snowglobe: 6 actions. You create a magical snowglobe. If this snowglobe takes 1 point of damage, it will explode and unleash a small blizzard on everyone within 6 spaces of it. Everyone affected takes 4d8 damage and loses 4 actions on their next 3 turns. Arcana vs Fortitude.
Sunburst: 6 actions. You bring down an intense beam of light energy upon a target, dealing 6d8 fire damage (no ignition) and blinding them for 3 turns. If you cast for another 3 actions, the energy releases from the target in a globe, damaging all targets within 4 spaces of them for 3d8 fire damage (no ignition). Arcana vs Will.
Imprisonment: 18 actions. You magically imprison a target, retaining them to a single space. While imprisoned, the target does not age, take damage, or use actions. The spell must have a condition of release, which you must discuss with your GM. Manners of imprisonment are Burial, Caging, Chains, or Pocket Dimension. Lasts until released. Arcana vs Will.
Invulnerability: 6 actions. An ally you can see glows all the colors of the rainbow and is immune to all damage and special effects. Lasts for as long as you concentrate. You may keep casting this for 4 turns. Arcana vs Will.
Ethereal: 6 actions. You take a half step into the Arcane Realm, existing in both planes at the same time. You appear translucent in both planes, and everything that interacts with you (and you interact with) must take the lower of 2d20 rolls. You may move through objects on either plane, but will be pushed aside from them when the spell ends. Lasts 5 turns. Must roll 36+ Arcana.
Reverse Gravity: Reverse Gravity: Choose up to 10 allies or enemies that will not be affected by gravity for 4 turns. Melee attacks can only affect those who are adjacent and at the same height, but all other actions remain the same. (WIS)
Nuke: 24 actions. You summon a nuclear bomb. If activated (or it takes 5+ damage), it will detonate, dealing 100d10 acid damage to everyone within 4 miles, and +300 fire damage to everyone within 1 mile. Anyone who is killed by this detonation is turned to ash. Must roll 36+ Arcana.
Wish: 6 actions. You speak into the universe to grant a wish. This wish will either cast any spell you know of, or have a different effect. You will want to be as concise as possible with this wish, as your GM can grant it in any manner they choose. The greater the effect of your wish, the greater burden you may bear. Upon casting any wish, your Strength is reduced to 0 if it is not already there, which lasts 3 days. Casting any spell after this will deal 1d10 damage to you until you have a long rest. Finally, for each subsequent cast of Wish, you must roll another d20 and take the lowest of the rolls. Must roll 36+ Arcana.
Crown Of Stars: 10 actions. A halo of 7 small bright points circles above your head. For 1 action, you may send one of these motes to a target within 15 spaces. If an enemy, they take 1d8 arcane damage, bypassing armor. If an ally, they gain a (stacking) shield for 1d8 Temp HP lasting 3 turns. The "crown" lasts for 1 hour or until all motes are used. Arcana vs Will.
Forcecage: 5 actions. You create a cube of force in a 4x4 area. Nothing physical can enter or leave this cube until called off, not even yourself. You may keep casting this, so long as you only make Move actions. Lasts until called off. Must roll 36+ Arcana.
Prismatic Ball:
18 actions. You summon a small, immaterial glowing rainbow ball that hovers in a nearby space. On your turn, the ball may float up to 3 spaces and make 1 attack, free of actions. Attacks are as follows:
Acid: 1d4 Acid damage to a target, reduces their Armor and weapon damage by 1. Arcana vs Reflex.
Fire: 1d12 Fire damage to a target, 1/3 ignition chance. Arcana vs Reflex.
Frost: 1d4 Frost damage to a target, who loses 2 actions on their next 3 turns. Arcana vs Fortitude.
Lightning: 1d10 Lightning damage to a target (tripled if armor is 7 or higher). Arcana vs Reflex.
Sonic: 1d6 Sonic damage to a target, who is Muted and Deafened on their next turn. Arcana vs Will.
The ball lasts 10 turns.
Knockback: X actions. Deal 1W damage to an adjacent target and knock them back 3 spaces. Weapon vs Fortitude.
Bounce: X actions. Attack an adjacent target for 1W damage, then jump to another target within 5 spaces and deal 1W damage to them. Add a combo point for each successful attack. Weapon vs Reflex.
Swap: X actions. You swap spaces with your Pokemon. The action cost is 1 for every 3 spaces that you are apart, with a maximum range of 18. Must roll 18+ Animal Handling.
Polevault: X actions. Requires Staff-class weapon. Deal 2W damage to an adjacent target and leap up to 3 spaces away. If you land on another target, shift them 1 space. Finesse Attack vs Reflex.
Double Jump: Passive. Your max Jumping speed is equal to your Acrobatics score. Acrobatics.
Staff Supremacy:
Passive. You gain +3 to all Attack skills while wielding a Staff-class weapon. Weapon Attack.

Upgrade: +6 to all Attack skills.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 Attack rolls.
Staff Versatility: Passive. You now count the Caber, Giant Club, Trident, Lance, Scythe, Shock Baton, Javelin, Longbow, and Spear all as Staff-class weapons.
Scope Out: 4 actions. Add a combo point. A target that you can see suffers -4 to their attack roll on their next turn. Perform vs Will.
Paralyzer: X actions. Attack a target next to you for 1W damage and paralyze 1 random limb for 3 turns. Add 1 limb for each combo point and lose all combo points. Weapon vs Fortitude.
Sweep: X actions. Trips all adjacent targets. Finesse Attack vs Fortitude.
Dodge: Reaction. If you are being attacked against your Fortitude, you may spend 2 actions from your next turn to use your Reflex instead. You must make this choice before the attack roll. This can be done as often as you'd like in battle, provided that you have the actions to spare. Reflex.
Whirl:
Reaction. Requires Staff-class weapon. Spend 2 of your actions next turn to gain +7 Reflex against a Ranged attack. This can be used after the target's attack roll. Reflex vs Ranged Attack.

Upgrade: This can be done as often as you like during battle.

Upgrade: You also gain +7 Fortitude against a Light attack.
Force: Passive. All successful attacks made with a Staff-class weapon pushes your target back 1 space.
Backflip: 1 action. Add a combo point. Then, flip up to 6 spaces away. Must roll 20+ Acrobatics.
Concussion: X actions. Deals 1W damage to a target next to you and stuns them for 1 turn. Add +4 accuracy to this attack for each combo point and lose all combo points. Weapon vs Fortitude.
Parkour: Passive. Your max Climbing speed is equal to your Acrobatics score. Also, climbing costs 1 less action. Acrobatics.
Staff Mastery: Passive. Your attacks with Staff-class weapons costs -1 action, down to a minimum of 1.
Staff Extension: Passive. Attacks and abilities used with your Staff-class weapon now reach 1 space farther.
Flair: 4 actions. Instantly add 3 combo points. Must roll 20+ Perform.
Swing In: 6 actions. Swing over next to a target you can see, dealing damage equal to your Athletics. Add 1 damage for each space swung over and 2 damage for each combo point. Lose all combo points. Acrobatics vs Reflex.
Tumble: Passive. If a melee attack against you is unsuccessful, you may instantly move 3 spaces. Acrobatics.
Athlete: Passive. You may use your Acrobatics score instead of Athletics. Acrobatics.
Fastball Special: 6 actions. An adjacent ally (with at least 10 Athletics) can throw you at a target, dealing damage equal to your HP. You land next to the target, take no damage, and gain a combo point. Acrobatics vs Reflex.
Wire: 5 actions. You possess an ultrathin wire that can be thrown up to 20 spaces away. You can control the direction and positioning of this wire seemingly with your mind, and it can attach to nearly any surface. You can use this to trip enemies or to tie 1 up completely, preventing them from making attacks and moving for 1 turn. Add 1 turn for each combo point and lose all combo points. Acrobatics vs Reflex.
Dramatic Effect: Reaction. When an attack successfully hits you, you may move up to 3 spaces. If you move adjacent to a target, you may deal half the damage you took to them. You still take full damage. Acrobatics vs Reflex.
Roll With It: Passive. You take half damage from falling. Also, you cannot be tripped or knocked down. Reflex.
Iron Defender:
600 actions. Constructs a mechanical creature that does your bidding. Their Stats are based on your own Skills:

HP = Crafting Armor/Clothes x4
Armor = Crafting Armor/Clothes
Fortitude = Hardware: Machinery
Reflex = Hardware: Vehicles
Will = Software
Light Attack = Crafting Weapons/Tools

Other Stats will ultimately be determined by what form you build your companion in. While your Defender is next to you, you may use Hardware: Machinery to "repair" it. Must roll 20+ Weapons/Tools Crafting and 20+ Enchantments.
Enhance Capacity:
24 actions. You increase an object's Enchantment Capacity (EC) by 1 level. This is irreversible. The object is now considered a magical device.

Upgrade: You increase the object's EC by up to 3 levels.
Attunement:
6 actions. You remove a magical item's enchantment, storing it within yourself (it does not affect you). You may then use this ability to store the enchantment in a non-magical item. You can absorb up to Level 3 enchantments. Must roll 22+ Enchantments.

Upgrade: You can absorb up to Level 7 enchantments.
Artisan:
Passive. You gain +3 Weapons/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: +6 Weapons/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: You may take the higher of 2d20 rolls when using Weapons/Tools Crafting.
Homing Missiles: Passive. You gain +10 Ranged Attack with launched weapons (guns, bows). If you have Piercing Shot, your shots will seek out any targets within 3 spaces of your previous target. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Scribe: X actions. Requires writing materials and paper. You may use either Enchantments or Arcana to inscribe a spell into a sheet of paper. Magic can only be infused onto a physical sheet. Inscribing the spell requires a roll of (Spell Level x1.25) or higher, and takes 1 (+ Spell Level) minutes. Arcana/Enchantments.
Blast Rod: X actions. You deal 1W damage to a target. If your attack was ranged, an electric bolt jumps to another target within 5 spaces and deals 2d10 lightning damage to them (doubled if Armor above 7). Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Conjure Ammunition: 24 actions. You summon 100 arrows, bolts, or bullets. This can only be used once per day, and the ammunition vanishes at the end of the day. Arcana.
Hookshot:
24 actions. Requires 5 Wire and 2 Steel. You create a grappling gun that can be fired for 4 actions. If it hits a being, they take 1d10 damage. For another 4 actions, you may pull yourself toward the object, or it to you (size plays an effect here). Weapons/Tools Crafting.
Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Defender Reinforcement: 4 actions. If your Iron Defender is adjacent to you, you may toughen it up to receive 10 (+Crafting: Vehicles) Temporary Hit Points. Attacks on these Hit Points cannot be reduced by Armor, they must be depleted before your friend can be hurt again, and they last until either depleted or the end of battle.
Touch Of Mastery: 3 actions. You touch a weapon. This weapon's attacks may roll for Light Attack, Heavy Attack, Ranged Attack, or Finesse Attack. Lasts 10 turns. Enchantments.
Ion Cannon: 6 actions. Launches an Ion Pulse at a spot within 10 spaces. When the Ion Pulse lands, it deals 4d6 damage to everyone within 1 space. This damage bypasses 8 Armor. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Disintegrate: 6 actions. You turn an object to dust. You must be holding or adjacent to the object. If it is a weapon, the one wielding it is Disarmed. If it is a piece of armor, the one wearing it loses its benefits. Must roll 30+ Arcana.
Flamethrower:
600 actions. Requires 6 Steel. You create a flamethrower. Wielding it requires 8 Finesse Attack and 4 Heavy Attack. For 6 actions, it blasts out fire in a 1x3 area, dealing 2d12 fire damage (1/3 ignition chance) to all enemies within it. Can keep going up to 2 turns. Recharging takes 8 actions. Weapons/Tools Crafting.
Finesse Attack vs Fortitude.
Infusion: X actions. You infuse a non-magical item with a spell. Once per battle, the item is able to cast this spell free of actions. Only 1 spell can fit within an item. Casting time for this spell is 12 actions + (2 x Spell Level). Enchantments.
Tactical Detonation: X actions. Launch a missile that latches onto your targeted surface and activates. On any turn after it has been activated, you may detonate it, dealing 4d12 fire damage to everyone within 3 spaces of it. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Turret: 600 actions. Constructs a portable Turret that can be deployed on an adjacent space for 12 actions. When complete, the Turret will independently fire at a target within 20 spaces (using your Hardware: Weaponry for its RA) for 2d8 damage each turn. The Turret has HP equal to 2x your Hardware: Weaponry, cannot move, and has no Armor or Defenses. Only 1 Turret can be deployed at a time. Lasts until destroyed or picked up. Must roll 26+ Weapon/Tools Crafting.
Defender Upgrade 1:
Requires 13 Weapons/Tools Crafting and 13 Enchantments.

600 actions. Choose 1 Upgrade:

A/V Link: You may see and hear what your Defender does, at the cost of your own senses. You can use this ability whenever.

Defense Array: Your Defender uses 4 actions to give itself a shield of 20 Temp HP. Lasts 5 turns or until destroyed.

Extra Sensors: Your Defender can take the higher of 2d20 Detection rolls.

Grappler: Your Defender has hooks attached. Its basic attacks will now grapple its target, holding them in place. Hardware: Weapons/Tools vs Fortitude.

Harness: Riding atop your Defender no longer requires a Piloting roll.

Locomotive Adaptation: Your Defender's Acrobatics score is doubled.

Power Build: Your Defender's Athletics score is doubled.

Reach: The range of your Defender's attacks is doubled.

Reserves: Your Defender uses 4 actions to heal itself for 1d8 HP.

Tension Springs: Your Defender gain 2 Move actions per turn.

Dimensional Punch: 6 actions. Spends 6 Chakra. You punch a target next to you. Your attack roll must surpass their Fortitude, Reflex, and Will. If you succeed, they are erased from this plane of existence. Light Attack vs Fortitude/Reflex/Will.
Realign:
600 actions. Spends 6 Chakra. You perform a ritual on a willing ally. This ally forgets up to 3 Abilities that they have learned, and lose 9 of their spent Skill points. The ally cannot unlearn a lower-level Ability that would prevent a higher-level Ability from being used. As the ritual completes, this ally may accumulate new Skills and Abilities according to their level. After the ritual, the ally will suffer a -5 exhaustion penalty to all d20 rolls for roughly 20 minutes. Spirituality.

Upgrade: This ally forgets up to 9 Abilities that they have learned, and lose 27 of their spent Skill points.

Martial Arts Mastery: Passive. While Unarmed, your Light Attack costs -1 action, down to a minimum of 1. Light Attack vs Fortitude.
Mark:
4 actions. You mark a target within 5 spaces. Only you will know the target has been marked - it will not break Stealth. Upgrade: Your next attack will deal an extra 10 damage (bypassing armor).
Center Self:
24 actions. You become Centered, generating Ki. You gain +1 to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will. Wearing above 5 Armor or wielding any Heavy weapons will instantly Uncenter you. Spirituality vs Will.

Upgrade: +2 to all Defenses.

Upgrade: +4 to all Defenses.
Flying Weapon: X actions. Leap up to 3 spaces away, then attack a target next to where you land for 1W damage. Weapon vs Reflex.
Charge Thrown:
4 actions. Must be Centered. You charge any weapon with mystic energy, giving it your choice of effect when thrown. This will uncenter you.

Sparks: The weapon does no damage, but instead explodes into sparks that confuses all targets in a 2x2 area for 1 turn.

Sharpen: The weapon bypasses 2 Armor.

Return: The weapon returns to you instantly after dealing damage.

Split: The weapon splits into 2 and deals 1W damage to 2 targets of your choice.

Poisons Master: Passive. You gain +10 Survival when detecting poison, and +10 Weapons/Tools Crafting when applying poison to weapons.
Burning Soul: 3 actions. Must be Centered. You may add your Arcana skill to all Charisma-based rolls. Lasts 5 turns.
Micro Step: 1 action. Must be Centered. You step in between dimensions. While doing so, you resemble a flying ribbon. You gain +7 Reflex and can fly 1 space per action. Finesse Weaponry:
Passive. You gain +3 Finesse Attack.

Upgrade: +6 Finesse Attack.

Reiki: 6 actions. Must be Centered. You heal a target next to you for 1d12 HP and remove a negative effect from them. You may use this as often as you like in battle. Insight vs Will.

Absorb: Passive. On any turn you deal damage, you may uncenter yourself to gain Temporary HP equal to the damage you dealt. This can be done as often as you wish during battle. Arcana.

3 actions. You bestow Holy energy onto a target within 5 spaces, granting them +2 to all Defenses. Lasts 5 turns. Spirituality vs Will.

Consecrate: 4 actions. The ground within 3 spaces of you becomes holy. Enemies in this area take 1d8 Holy damage each turn, doubled if they are a Demon or Undead. Lasts 4 turns. Spirituality vs Will.

Judgment Of Weakness: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target's melee attacks only deal half damage for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Chains: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target is slowed to 1 Move action for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Incompetency: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target cannot make any attacks other than their Basic Attack for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Misery: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon) and magnetizing them to their closest ally. The two targets are stuck together for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Exclusion: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target has -3 Armor and all Defenses for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Fury: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 5d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target cannot be the victim of another Judgment for 3 turns. Aggression vs Will.
Judgment Of Retribution: 4 actions. You judge a target within 15 spaces, dealing 2d8 Holy damage (doubled if Undead or Demon). That target takes 1d4 damage (bypassing armor) whenever they attack you or an ally for 3 turns. A target can only have 1 Judgment at a time. Aggression vs Will.
Compelled Duel: 2 actions. You command a target within 10 spaces to duel. If you or that target attack anyone other than each other, you must take the lesser of 2d20 rolls to do so. Lasts until one of you dies or until the end of battle. Aggression vs Will.

Sacred Protection: 3 actions. You encase a target within 10 spaces in a holy bubble that absorbs all damage and negative effects. Lasts until your next turn. Spirituality vs Will.

Death Ward: 60 actions. You perform a ritual on a target within 5 spaces. When an attack would kill that target, it instead breaks the Death Ward and leaves them at 1d10 HP. Lasts until Death Ward is dismissed or broken. Only 1 target can have a Death Ward per Paladin. Spirituality vs Will.
Call Greater Steed: 24 actions. Requires Call Steed. You call a spirit that takes the form of an animal or vehicle to a nearby space. 5 Actions. You throw a bubble of acid at an target in sight. On a hit, it reduces their Armor by 3, as well as the Armor of 1 target next to them. Arcana vs Reflex.

Fire Breath:
6 Actions. You blast fire from your mouth, dealing 1d12 damage to everyone in a 1x3 line from you with a 1/3 ignition chance. You may keep this going for multiple turns, but can only cast once per battle. Arcana vs Reflex.

3 Actions. Blasts an adjacent enemy with frost, dealing 2d4 damage and trapping them in chains of ice for 2 turns. Arcana vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: Healing dice are doubled (2d4, 2d8, 2d12).
Favored Enemy - Beasts: Passive. You gain +2 to all Defenses, Damage, and Attacks when battling Beasts.
Victory Run: Passive. Whenever you successfully catch a new species of beast, you gain +2 to all your d20 rolls for 5 turns of combat.
Charming: 3 actions. You and your Pokemon   both gain +6 Persuasion for 3 turns. You must stay next to each other during this time. Persuasion.
Kite: 2 actions. You and your Pokemon gain +10 Aggression against 1 target. Each turn, you both lose -2 of this bonus. Aggression vs Will.
Experience: Passive. When catching a beast, add 1 for each beast you have of that type to your Animal Handling roll.
Pin Down: 5 actions. You throw your weight onto a target next to you. You take their space, knock them prone, and prevent movement. Lasts as long as you keep them down. Athletics vs Athletics.
Deterrent:
Reaction. When a target moves next to you, your Pokemon may make a Basic Attack against them, provided that they are within range. Usable once per battle. Light Attack vs Defense.

Upgrade: Your Pokemon can use this 3x per battle.
Health Tie: 4 actions. You and your Pokemon split all damage taken between you, no matter your distance from each other. Lasts 5 turns. Animal Handling.
Hunker Down: 2 actions. You and your Pokemon both hunker down, gaining +4 Armor and +7 Will, but cannot move or make any attacks. Lasts for as long as you concentrate. Your Pokemon must be next to you for the entire duration.
Fast Hands:
1 action. You only use 1 action to switch between Pokemon instead of 6. Only usable once per battle.

Upgrade: Usable 2x per battle.

Upgrade: Usable 3x per battle.
Rejuvy Dart:
Requires PokePotion.

60 actions. Requires darts. You apply a PokePotion to up to 10 darts. When thrown at a beast, it deals 1 damage (bypassing armor). For the next 10 turns, it heals the beast 1d4 HP each turn (1d6 HP for Pokemon). Must roll 12+ Weapon/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: Healing dice are doubled (2d4, 2d6).
Mount: Passive. You may now ride atop your Pokemon with no penalties. However, your Pokemon is limited to 5 Move actions while mounted.
Multitask: X actions. If you and your Pokemon attack different targets this turn, you both may take the higher of 2d20 rolls. Must roll 15+ Animal Handling.
Solo: 3 actions. Choose a beast that will only be affected by attacks made by you and your Pokemon. You and your Pokemon gain +3 to all Attacks, +1 damage, and 10 Temporary HP. Lasts for as long as you keep the target's attention. Aggression vs Will.
Waver:
Requires Vanish.

Passive. Whenever you switch Pokemon, you gain +12 Reflex until your next turn.
Revitalize: 4 actions. Both you and your Pokemon can reuse 1 feat that you already used this battle.
Evolution 1: All of your Basic Pokemon that can evolve become 1st-Stage Pokemon.
Evolution 2: All of your 1st-Stage Pokemon that can evolve become 2nd-Stage Pokemon.
Shockstrike: 3 actions. You strike an adjacent target for 1W damage and reduce their actions by 2 on their next turn. If your held weapon is Ranged, you deal no damage, but instead roll 1d6. On a 3+, the target is instead Stunned on their next turn. Weapon vs Fortitude.
Action Hero: Passive. You gain +1 Light Attack and +1 damage for every target you can see while you are Unarmed. Unarmed vs Fortitude.
Dash Attack: Passive. If you successfully attack with both weapons while dual-wielding, you gain +2 Move actions that last until the end of your turn.
Dodge Roll:
Reaction. Upon a successful physical attack against you, you negate all damage and effects of the attack and instead roll 2 spaces away. You suffer -5 Fortitude and Reflex for the rest of the battle. Reflex.

Upgrade: You may use this 2x in one battle. The penalty stacks.

Upgrade: You may use this 3x in battle. The penalty stacks.
Snap Shot: Reaction. You fire your weapon at any time for 1W damage. It costs no actions, though it will still cost ammo. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Field Medic:
Passive. All Medikits you carry have +1 Range and cost -1 action to use, down to a minimum of 1. Medicine.

Upgrade: +1 Range, -1 action.
Power Burst:
3 actions. Choose 1 benefit:

-All melee attacks gain +2 knockback.

-Gain +10 Temp HP.

-Your Climb, Jump, and Swim speed is equal to your Acrobatics score. If your Acrobatics is less than 6, it becomes 6.

Lasts 3 turns. Perform.
Power Pose: 1 action. Can only be done after a successful attack. You make an Intimidate roll with a +10 bonus. Intimidate vs Will.
Rejoice:
Reaction. Any time you make a successful melee attack, you may move 1 space.

Upgrade: Triggers from a successful melee or ranged attack.

Upgrade: Attacks do not have to be successful to trigger movement.
Recoil:
Reaction. Any time you are successfully hit by a melee attack, you may move 1 space.

Upgrade: Successfully hit by a melee or ranged attack.

Upgrade: Attacks do not have to be successful to trigger movement.
Command Coin: 12 actions. You now have a Command Coin that can be used to warp you from where you are to a Preset location. After casting, you are in the Ether, unable to perceive anything or make actions, for 60 actions. You must already be in a location to store it as a Preset, which takes 18 actions. The Command Coin can only hold up to 3 Presets; adding a 4th will require you to drop a previous one.
Morphin' Time: 12 actions. You summon a black or white suit of armor that can only be worn by you. You may dismiss the suit for 2 actions. While donned, no other armor (including head, hands and feet) can be worn. The suit provides Temp HP equal to your Level, and Armor equal to your (Acrobatics + Intimidate) / 2, rounded down. Lasts until dismissed.
Grenade Mod:
600 actions. You build a Mod Pack that automatically modifies all grenades you carry. Switching between Mods takes 6 actions. You may use any of these Mods:

Bouncing Bettie: Your grenade will bounce endlessly until it comes within range of a target.

Detonator: Your grenade may detonate either after 6 actions or later on as a Reaction.

Flashbang: Your grenade deals -3 damage, but stuns everyone hit for 1 turn.

Radius: Your grenade's blast range is extended by 2 spaces.

Shock: Your grenade deals lightning damage instead, tripled to everyone with 7+ Armor.

Transfusion: You heal 1d4 HP for everyone hit by your grenade.

Winter: Your grenade limits Move actions to 2 for everyone hit.

Hardware: Weaponry.
Zeo Cell:
600 actions. You attach a Zeo Cell to a Ranged weapon, granting it +1 Ranged Attack. Zeo Cells are detachable, and can hold a Zeo Charge that modifies the weapon. Must roll 12+ Weapons/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: You can modify a Ranged weapon to carry 2 Zeo cells. Must roll 20+ Weapons/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: You can modify a Ranged weapon to carry 3 Zeo cells. Must roll 28+ Weapons/Tools Crafting.

Upgrade: You can modify a Ranged weapon to carry 4 Zeo cells. Must roll 34+ Weapons/Tools Crafting.
Burst Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Burst Charge into a Zeo Cell. The attached weapon's successful attacks knock back its target 1 space (if 1H) or 2 spaces (if 2H). Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Deflector Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Deflector Charge into a Zeo Cell. If the attached weapon is 2H, it emits a plasma shield, granting the user small cover (+5 Reflex) while in use. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Demo Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Demo Charge into a Zeo Cell. Once per battle, the user can add +2 actions to the attached weapon's attack. In doing so, a successful shot will deal half damage to everyone next to the target. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Medic Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Medic Charge into a Zeo Cell. The attached weapon's ammo is modified to heal HP rather than deal damage. Amount is still affected by the target's Armor. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Muffle Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Muffle Charge into a Zeo Cell. When used while in Stealth, the attached weapon's sound is quelched. Roll 1d6. On a 2+, the attack will not break Stealth. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Prism Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Prism Charge into a Zeo Cell. Once per battle, the attached weapon can modify its ammunition to deal random elemental damage (decided by a d6 roll). Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Seeker Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Seeker Charge into a Zeo Cell. The user can add +2 actions to the attached weapon's attack. If so, and the attack misses its target, it will find the next closest one, allowing another attack attempt. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Sting Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Sting Charge into a Zeo Cell. The attached weapon allows its user to make an automatic Aggression roll against their target for each successful attack. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Zoom Charge: 600 actions. You upload a Zoom Charge into a Zeo Cell. The attached weapon grants +7 Ranged Attack against targets over 20 spaces away, and +3 Ranged Attack against targets within 20 spaces. Must roll +12 Hardware: Weaponry.
Red Suit:
Requires Morphin' Time.

Passive. Your suit now grants you +2 Fortitude, Athletics, and Aggression. It is permanently Red.
Blue Suit:
Requires Morphin' Time.

Passive. Your suit now grants you +2 Will, Piloting/Driving, and Hardware: Vehicles. It is permanently Blue.
Pink Suit:
Requires Morphin' Time.

Passive. Your suit now grants you +2 Reflex, Insight, and Persuasion. It is permanently Pink.
Green Suit:
Requires Morphin' Time.

Passive. Your suit now grants you +2 Deception, Weapons/Tools Crafting, and Survival. It is permanently Green.
Yellow Suit:
Requires Morphin' Time.

Passive. Your suit now grants you +2 Ranged Attack, Hardware: Weaponry, and Detection. It is permanently Yellow.
Enduring: Passive. Action Hero also heals you for 1 HP each turn while Unarmed.
Tactical Retreat: Passive. Your Dash Attack now grants +4 Move actions, as long as you use them to move away from your target.
Buzzer: 60 actions. Constructs a Buzzer that you can attach to a person. If that target has a lasting psychic effect (Sleep, Charm, Hypnosis, Taunt, etc), the Buzzer will detect it and attempt to shock them out of it. Each turn, the target rolls 1d8. On a 3 or higher, they are instantly shocked out of the psychic attack and they can continue their turn normally. Must roll 20+ Weapon/Tools Crafting.
Dissuade: Passive. Upon using Dodge Roll, you may make a Persuasion roll free of action costs. Persuasion vs Will.
Flirt With Death: 2 actions. You force an adjacent target to attack you. If successful, you gain +7 to all Defenses against that target. Lasts 3 turns. Aggression vs Will.
Slice And Dice: Passive. Hit And Run now activates with 1H weapon attacks.
Stunning: Passive. Using Snap Shot lets you use an Intimidation roll free of action costs. Upon success, you slow all targets within 5 spaces by -2 actions on their next turn. Intimidation.
Throwdown: 3 actions. While holding your weapon over an adjacent target, activate its secret gravity trigger to knock them prone and keep them pinned down. The weapon must stay atop them for the duration, but the trigger is coded only to your touch. Lasts 10 turns or until deactivated. Hardware: Weaponry vs Fortitude.
Ram: 6 actions. Charge to a target within 4 spaces and deal (3x Unarmed) damage to them, stunning them for 1 turn. Roll 1d6. On a 3 or lower, you are also stunned for 1 turn.
Landspeeder: 600 actions. Requires 5 Steel. Constructs a 1-man speeder vehicle that hovers 1 space off the ground and moves at 3 spaces per action. Requires Piloting/Driving rolls of 15+ to pilot during combat. Must roll 26+ Hardware: Vehicles to build.
Double Swing:
Passive. After every melee attack you make, you may roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you make an extra melee weapon attack.

Upgrade: Activates on a roll of 4+.

Upgrade: You automatically make an extra weapon attack.
Cover Fire:
Requires an ally within 5 spaces.

X actions. You suffer -3 Ranged Attack. However, a target within weapon range, and everyone next to them, suffer -10 Ranged attack. This effect applies whether your weapon attack is successful or not. You may keep using this as long as you have ammo and keep concentrating, not moving or making other attacks. Ranged Attack vs Reflex.
Rescue: Reaction. If a target ally within 5 spaces is successfully hit by a ranged attack, you may instantly jump in front of them and take the attack instead. This will cost you 3 actions on your next turn. Must roll 12+ Acrobatics.
Grenadier: Passive. You wield Grenade Launchers with extra finesse. You gain +10 Range with them and reloading them costs -1 action (down to a minimum of 1). Grenades launched from them deal 3d12+2 damage to everyone within 6 spaces, with a 3-space knockback.
Zord:
18 actions. You summon and teleport to a Zord, a Huge mechanical beast of your choosing that towers up to 10 spaces tall. You are the pilot of the Zord, and all your actions direct its own. Its Stats are as follows:
Max HP: 4x your own
Fortitude: 2x your own
Reflex: Equal to your own
Will: 20
Armor: 4
Light Attack: 10+ your own
Heavy Attack: 10+ your own
Ranged Attack: 5+ your own
Damage and damage type are dependent upon your chosen beast. Up to 5 Zords may be combined with each other. If so, their Stats are also added together. Lasts 8 turns or until the end of battle.

Red:
Head Ram: Charge to an enemy within 4 spaces and deal STR damage to them, stunning them for 1 turn. Roll 1d6, and on a 3 or lower, you are also stunned for 1 turn. (STR)
Knockback: Deal 1W damage to an adjacent enemy and knock them back 6 spaces. (STR)
Lift: You hold up an adjacent enemy with 1 hand. That enemy cannot move or make ranged attacks, but can attempt to break free with a STR roll at least 3 times greater than your STR. While lifting an enemy, you cannot use that hand for anything else. You can use this as many times as you have hands. (STR)

Blue:
Buzzer: Constructs a Buzzer that you or an ally can attach to their person. On a 3 or higher, they are instantly shocked out of the psychic attack and they can continue their turn normally. (INT)
Turret: Spend a turn deploying a Turret on an adjacent space. When complete, the Turret will fire at the closest enemy for 1d8 damage each turn until destroyed or until the end of battle. The Turret has HP equal to your Intellect, cannot move, and has no Armor, Will, or Reflex. Only 1 Turret can be deployed at a time. (INT)
Upgrade Ranged: You can upgrade ranged weapons to deal an extra 1d6 damage. (INT)

Pink:
Flirt With Death: You Intimidate an adjacent enemy, forcing them to attack you for 3 turns. If successful, you gain +7 Reflex against all physical attacks from that enemy during that time. (CHA)
Miscellaneous Weapon Proficiency: You can wield any
random object (except for actual weapons) as easily as if it were your lifelong weapon.
Sweep: You trip all adjacent enemies. If tripped, an enemy cannot make a melee attack, has -3 Reflex, and can only roll around at 1 speed. They may spend a turn to get back up. (DEX)

Black:
Double Swing: After every melee attack you make, you may roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you make an extra melee Basic Attack. (STR)
Rescue: If an ally within 3 spaces is successfully hit by a ranged attack, you may instantly jump in front of them and take the attack instead. (DEX)
Retaliate: After every successful attack an adjacent enemy makes against you, you may instantly strike back for half the damage. (DEX)

Yellow:
Cover Fire: Choose an ally. For the remainder of the battle, whenever an enemy moves adjacent to that ally, you may make a Basic Attack against that enemy. This can only be done on the enemy’s Move action, not your ally’s. (DEX)
Piercing Shot: You make a ranged attack for 1W damage to an enemy and all enemies in a line behind them. (DEX)
Scatter Shot: You make a ranged attack that deals 1W damage in a cone shape. Each projectile stops after hitting its first target. (DEX)
Wave: 8 actions. You soak all enemies in a 2-by-2 space area with a wave of water, limiting them to 3 Move actions, reducing all their Attacks by 2, and preventing them from getting bonus effects from critical rolls. Spirituality vs Fortitude.
Pressurize:
2 actions. You compress a body of water, up a Small amount, to become almost solid. Attacks made with this water add 1d6 damage. Also, you and chosen targets running at full speed may run across a pressurized body of water.

Upgrade: 3 actions. Pressurizes up to a Large amount of water.

Upgrade: 4 actions. Pressurizes up to a Gargantuan amount of water.
Stream:
4 actions. You pull up to 50 liters of water from a source within 3 spaces and flow it around your person. This limits your Move actions to 3, but reduces the action cost of other attacks by 2. Lasts 5 turns. Must roll 12+ Spirituality.

Upgrade: Reduces action cost of other attacks by 4.
Water Jet: 8 actions. You pull water from a source within 3 spaces and blast a target within 3 spaces with it, knocking them back 3 spaces each turn and preventing them from using Move actions. Lasts for as long as you concentrate, not making any other attacks or moves. Spirituality vs Reflex.
Water Whip: 8 actions. You lash out up to 5 liters of water like a whip, dealing 1d10 damage to a target within 2 spaces. Spirituality vs Reflex.
Envelop: 10 actions. You surround a target within 3 spaces in a ball of water. Their Move actions are limited to 2, they cannot make physical attacks, they gain +5 Reflex and Fortitude, and after 3 turns, they start losing 20% of their Total HP each turn. The target can attempt to escape the water ball with an Acrobatics roll higher than your initial roll. Lasts as long as you concentrate, not moving or making other attacks. Spirituality vs Reflex.
Phase Shift: 3 actions. You turn any amount of a body of water within 5 spaces into ice or fog. Anyone stuck in ice cannot use Move actions. Anyone in fog is considered blinded. This will stun you on your next turn. Lasts 10 turns. Must roll 22+ Spirituality.
Shape Water: 9+ actions. You manipulate any water in the vicinity to form whatever shape you want. For each size class above Large, you must spend 3 more actions bending this move. The shape can take up any unoccupied space and lasts for as long as you concentrate. Must roll 20+ Spirituality.
Water Cloak: 6 actions. Draws water around you to move as you do and last for as long as you concentrate, not making other attacks. You can direct the water around you to grant you +4 Reflex or shape it into Bludgeoning weapons that can attack targets up to 5 spaces away for 2d8 damage. Spirituality vs Reflex.
Water Dome: 1+ action. You repel all water within 1 space. You may spend more actions to repel water further (1 space per action). This lasts for as long as you concentrate, not making any other attacks. Must roll 16+ Spirituality.
Flexibility:
Passive. You may use Shape Water to control (and even siphon water from) the following liquids:
Alcoholic Drinks
Ink
Tea/Juice
Mud
Paint
Perfume
Stew/Soup
Fluidity: Passive. Phase Shift now has a range of 10 spaces, and only causes a -3 action penalty on your next turn.
Sweatbending: 3 actions. Requires at least 2 turns of combat or strenuous activity. You bend the sweat from your body, controlling a Tiny amount of water. Must roll Spirituality 20+.
Disable: 6 actions. Requires moonlight. You take control of a target's blood within 5 spaces, tripping them and forcing them to drop their weapons. Choosing this ability will lock you into the Bloodbender Talent Tree. Insight vs Fortitude.
Soothe: 6 actions. Requires 4 actions charging time to cover your hands with water. You heal yourself or an adjacent target for 1d6 HP each turn for as long as you concentrate. Neither you nor your target can move or make attacks during this time. Choosing this ability will lock you into the Healer Talent Tree. Medicine vs Will.
Grasping Roots: 6 actions. You take control of the grass in a 5x5-space area. The grass is elongated and grasps at the feet of all targets within the area, limiting them to 2 Move actions. Lasts for as long as you concentrate, not moving or making other attacks. Choosing this ability will lock you into the Swampbender Talent Tree. Survival vs Reflex.
Full Stop: 6 actions. Requires moonlight. You take control of a target's blood within 5 spaces, preventing them from making Move or Attack actions. Lasts for as long as you concentrate, making no Move or Attack actions. Insight vs Fortitude.
Ebb:
Passive. Soothe now affects up to 2 targets.

Upgrade: (Requires Flow) Soothe now affects up to 5 targets.
Flow:
Passive. Soothe now has a range of 5 spaces. If not yourself, your target is free to make Move and Attack actions.

Upgrade: Soothe now has a range of 10 spaces.
Swirl: Passive. The charging time for Soothe is now 1 action.
Vine Whip: 1 action. Take control of a vine within 5 spaces, treating it like a Whip weapon. For 1 action, the vine is able to lunge up to 3 spaces from its original space, but cannot leave its bounds. Attacks made with the vine roll Survival vs Reflex.
Control Movement:
Passive. While someone is affected by your Full Stop, you may move their body for 1 space per 2 actions. Lasts for as long as you concentrate, making no Move or Attack actions. Insight vs Fortitude.

Upgrade: 1 space per action.

Upgrade: (Requires Lift) 3 spaces per action.
Higher Healing:
Passive. Soothe now heals for 2d6 HP per turn.

Upgrade: 2d12 HP per turn.
Peace:
Passive. Soothe removes and prevents certain effects after being used on the same target repeatedly.
2 turns: Bleeding and taunts.
3 turns: Poison and charms.
4 turns: Disease and curses.
War Healer: Passive. You can now make Move actions while casting Soothe.
Consume: 4 actions. Requires abundant plantlife. You pull the freshwater out from all plants within 2 spaces, giving you up to a Small amount of water to use. This comes at the cost of the plantlife. Must roll 26+ Survival.
Hedge: 4 actions. Requires bush. Command a bush within 10 spaces to fire thorns at all targets within 4 spaces of itself. Thorns deal 1d4 damage (bypassing armor). Survival vs Reflex.
Vine Reach: Passive. Your Vine Whip can now lunge up to 10 spaces from its original space.
Lift: Passive. Your Control Movement ability can now lift your target into the air 1 space per action.
Turn Body:
Passive: Your Control Movement ability can force your target to make Basic attacks against another target within range. Basic attacks cost an extra +2 actions.

Upgrade: Basic attacks now cost their usual actions.
Reach For Blood: Passive. All of your Bloodbending abilities now have a range of 10.
Bubble:
Passive. Soothe now instantly produces a protective Bubble around your target, granting them +5 Temp HP. Continuous casting will replenish the Bubble to the maximum.

Upgrade: +20 Temp HP.
Growth:
6 actions. You bend life into the world within 5 spaces around you, speeding up plants' growth process. You may keep casting to grow bigger and more plants.
1 turn: Grass, moss, seaweed, and /or flowers. Requires Tiny water.
2 turns: Bushes and cacti. Requires Small water.
3 turns: Trees (with 5 vines each). Requires Large water.
Tree: 1 action. Take control of a tree within 5 spaces, treating it like a Caber weapon. The tree can twist and bend its branches, but is otherwise rooted. Attacks made with the vine roll Survival vs Fortitude.
Vine Snap:
Passive. Your Vine Whip now deals 2x damage.

Upgrade: 4x damage.
Ruthlessness: Passive: All of your Bloodbending abilities now cost -1 action, down to a minimum of 1.
Bloodthirst:
Passive. All of your bloodbending abilities can now affect 2 targets within range.

Upgrade: 5 targets within range.

Upgrade: 10 targets within range.
Jungler: Passive. Hedge and Tree can now be cast on up to 5 hedges and trees within range at once.
Vineyard: Passive. Vine Whip can now be cast on up to 5 vines within range at once.
Bloodbending Mastery: Passive. All Bloodbending abilities no longer require moonlight.
Swamp Sentinel:
Requires Tree and Vineyard. 12 actions. You surround yourself with plantlife to become a Huge-sized Swamp Sentinel. The Sentinel has 60 Temp HP, with no armor. The Sentinel wields a Tree arm (treat like a caber) and a Vines arm (treat like 5 whips) that each act independently. You can move the Sentinel 1 space per 2 Move actions. Lasts until dismissed, or all Temp HP is lost. Attacks made by the Sentinel roll your Survival.

Upgrade: Requires Growth. For 4 actions, you may spend a Tiny amount of water to gain back 1d10 Temp HP that has been lost. You cannot exceed the original 60 Temp HP.

Upgrade: Requires Hedge. Once per turn, the Sentinel fires thorns at all targets within 4 spaces. Thorns deal 1d4 damage (bypassing armor). Survival vs Reflex.
